Justice Bhuyan: Students Can't Be Punished For Asking Questions

Supreme Court Justice Dipak Misra stated that students cannot be punished for asking questions and that dissent is a constitutional responsibility. He also expressed regret that no legal expert has been appointed as a Supreme Court judge. These remarks were made during an event where Justice Bhuyan was present. The coverage highlights the importance of questioning and dissent within a constitutional framework.
